run_fastcsp_full_workflow: run the FastCSP crystal structure prediction workflow with a YAML config file and default stages
run_fastcsp_custom_stages: run the FastCSP CLI with a config file and custom workflow stages like generate and relax
run_fastcsp_generate_only: run the FastCSP generate stage to create crystal structures using Genarris from a config file
run_fastcsp_relax_and_filter: run the FastCSP relax and filter stages to perform UMA-based relaxations and deduplicate results
run_fastcsp_evaluate: run the FastCSP evaluate stage to compare predicted structures against experimental data
